description: Normalize sparse NinjaOne polling alerts without requiring an embedded device object.
Preserve an explicit provider-supplied external organization id.
Collect and deduplicate device ids only for events missing organization identity.
Resolve candidate device realms with one tenant-scoped mapping query per fetched batch.
Restrict mapping lookup to the ninjaone provider and asset entity type.
Enrich a device only when exactly one distinct non-empty external realm is mapped.
Leave missing, null, or ambiguous mappings unresolved so organization rules fail closed.
Preserve alert order and all normalized fields other than missing organization identity.
Keep shared rule organization filtering and first-match precedence unchanged.
Keep existing duplicate active/acknowledged alert skip behavior unchanged.
Keep maintenance suppression and resolved-alert retrigger behavior unchanged.
Use the existing mapping schema without migration or data rewrite.
Do not infer organization identity from client id.
Keep the change provider-specific to NinjaOne reconciliation polling.
Allow a newly encountered enriched alert to use the normal ticket creation and association pipeline.
